```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(SABER)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Overview

SABER is an R package for Bayesian inversion of radiative transfer models using in-situ data and prior distribution fitting.

## Load Sample Data

```{r}
# data("nomad_sample")
# head(nomad_sample)
nomad_sample <- sample_nomad()
```

## Fit Prior Distributions

```{r}
chl_prior <- make_prior(nomad_sample$chl, dist = "weibull", name = "chl")
ag_prior <- make_prior(nomad_sample$ag443, dist = "weibull", name = "ag440")
ad_prior <- make_prior(nomad_sample$ad443, dist = "weibull", name = "ad440")
bbp_prior <- make_prior(nomad_sample$bbp555, dist = "weibull", name = "anap440")
```

## Bundle Priors and Define Likelihood

```{r}
priors <- list(chl_prior, ag_prior, ad_prior, bbp_prior)
mock_likelihood <- function(params) {
  -sum((params - c(1, 0.5, 0.01, 0.005))^2)  # placeholder
}

prior_bundle <- make_prior_bundle(
  priors = priors,
  likelihood = mock_likelihood,
  lower = c(0, 0, 0, 0.0001),
  upper = c(30, 5, 0.5, 0.01)
)
```

## Run Inversion

```{r, eval=FALSE}
out <- run_inversion(prior_bundle, iterations = 5000)
summary(out)
```
